integrity: The proof uses the exact path Gram matrix and a positive quadratic-weight solution of the discrete Dirichlet equation on the two unreversed blocks. The weighted-distance identity proves global minimality and uniqueness and the flipped vertex is tested with an exact positive gap. Rational computations and independently solved small minimax instances are supplementary, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to one reversed arrow in a type-A path with at least three edges, in the standard directed-incidence Euclidean realization. It does not classify multiple reversals or all graph orientations.
title: One reversed arrow is screened from the minimum sphere of a directed path simplex
